title: Photochemical synthesis of Pd nanocatalysts stabilized by biomass-derived polymers: from colloidal to supported systems in batch and flow
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,33615-33627
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05019G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Irina Della-Cagnoletta, Silvia M. Soria-Castro, Fabrizio Politano, Sandra E. Martín, Paula M. Uberman, Gabriela Oksdath-Mansilla
A visible light-driven synthesis of PVP/CMC-stabilized Pd nanoparticles (Pd-NPs) on silica, in batch and continuous flow, was developed. The nanocatalysts achieve high turnover frequencies (TOFs) on tested reactions with excellent recyclability.
